About me

Based in Tangerang, Indonesia, I’m an e-commerce and digital marketing specialist who handles marketplace operations end to end: product listings, marketplace SEO, ads, inventory, and order fulfillment. I currently manage three brands across seven marketplace channels.

I combine hands-on store work with monthly sales analysis to shape pricing, promotions, and growth decisions. I’m a Digital Business student at Universitas Cakrawala, and I work in Bahasa Indonesia and professionally in English.

Vets Special · PT Raksasa Bisnis Indonesia · September

Shopee Ads: Hepatoprotector Cat 185g

Role: E-Commerce Staff / Campaign

Brief

Vets Special sells many products on Shopee, and the ad budget is limited to the brand’s monthly allocation. The goal was to put that budget behind the product most likely to return the best ROAS.

Process

  1. Choose the hero productI picked Hepatoprotector Cat 185g because it already had strong organic traffic and a high conversion rate, so ad spend would amplify demand that already existed.
  2. Make the listing easier to recognizeI added a healing logo and an organ logo to the product image, so buyers can see at a glance that it supports liver health.
  3. Set the budgetThe daily budget is set from the brand’s monthly budget, so spending lasts the whole month and delivers the maximum return (Rp25,000 per day in this campaign).
  4. Protect the algorithmBidding uses GMV Max with a ROAS target of 16. I chose this setting so that changes in ROAS do not disturb how the algorithm optimizes the ad.

Result

From 1 to 30 September, Rp746,596 in ad spend produced Rp21,458,870 in sales.
